diagnosis.priorBehavior: Production loadQuotaLedger accepted either the full immutable receipt identity hash or sha256(observed payload) without restricting the payload-only path to historical V0.1 schemas.
diagnosis.exploit: A V0.2 receipt could retain the same payload-only hash while changing status or expected_payload_json and still pass integrity validation.
diagnosis.risk: Current receipt metadata could be detached from immutable identity and create false valid ledger provenance under otherwise-authorized synthetic quota inputs.

currentReceiptRule: V0.2+ reservation/result receipts cannot use payload-only legacy hash.
V0.2+ must authenticate with the full immutable identity hash over check_id, check_type, expected_payload_json, observed_payload_json and status.
legacyV01Compatibility: Payload-only hash remains readable only for exact historical V0.1 reservation/result payload schema.
expected metadata must contain exactly directiveId/accountWide/paidUpgradeAuthorized with canonical values.
V0.1 reservation status must be QUOTA_RESERVATION_GRANTED.
V0.1 result status must equal payload.resultState and be RESULT_RECONCILED_ACCOUNT_DELTA or RESULT_ACCOUNT_USAGE_UNKNOWN.
Historical V0.1 rows are not rewritten.

positiveCases: Authentic V0.2 full-identity receipt remains VALID.
Authentic historical V0.1 payload-hash reservation remains VALID.
Authentic historical V0.1 payload-hash reservation+result pair remains VALID.
negativeCases: V0.2 payload-only hash plus status tamper rejected.
V0.2 payload-only hash plus expected metadata tamper rejected.
V0.2 full-identity row with status tamper and stale hash rejected.
V0.1 status/expected metadata/budget/schema/paid flag drift rejected.

reverify: Replay exact V0.2 legacy payload-only hash attack.
Replay V0.2 status and expected_payload_json mutation with unchanged legacy hash.
Confirm authentic V0.2 full identity hash remains valid.
Confirm authentic historical V0.1 payload-only reservation/result receipts remain valid.
Confirm V0.1 metadata/schema/budget/status drift rejects with ledger integrity invalid.
Confirm System1 write/read reserve remains false/null.
physicalClosureStillPending: bounded real multiwriter UTC-day grant/result/no-quota-collision evidence

dataLaneHandoff.rule: A7 source integrity is implemented, but DATA_LANE must still honor current read-budget/account evidence and all CORR-003 physical write prerequisites.
